text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I won...?
Against... Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I did it... I really did it!
I gave it everything I had, and now... waaah~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But unlike Ayabe-san, I don't really have anyone
I can dedicate a star to...
choice_data_list: I'm sure you'll find someone if you look.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, you're right. Then this win against Ayabe-san must be...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: To Opera O-san!
choice_data_list: Isn't calling them "peers" a bit weird?
Isn't calling them "peers" a bit weird?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu~, is that so?
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is for you, Trainer.
Please have it before it gets cold...
choice_data_list: No, no, I really can't accept this.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What are you... doing?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawa!?
Ayabe-san, um, well, uhh~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... for getting in your way.
It's just that this race is really important to me too, so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Nothing.
I don't really care.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I lost because of my own weakness.
That's all. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That was a great run, Meisho Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Ayabe-san wasn't angry after all, was she...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I won today, but still...
One day, though...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to run like that too.
Just like that, for someone else's sake.

Even with her dreams shattered, Admire Vega gazes up at the stars in broad daylight.
Meisho Doto gave a small bow to her back.
